shared_elements: low-relief human figure(s) in strict profile
elaborately curled/beaded hair and beard rendered as regular rows of curls
long fringed garment with patterned hem
raised arm holding an object in the hand
handled vessel/bucket-like object carried in one hand
figures striding with one foot advanced
justification: Both depict profile relief figures with the same conventions of stylised rows of curls for hair and beard, patterned fringed robes, and a hand raised holding an object while another hand carries a handled bucket-like vessel — a very specific shared attribute. The chief differences in content are that B shows a single large bird-headed winged being filling the panel, while A shows a repeated procession of wholly human figures in a horizontal frieze above a rosette border, with no wings and no animal head.
